summary: Implemented extension reload across protocol, agent-server, and app: protocol gained ExtensionReloadResult/reload request and event; session pool gained deferReload and reload-all; new extension-reload orchestrator ties catalog rescan, registry unlink, project-service refresh, session reload, and event broadcast; registry unlink/extensions.reload wired into transport router and app store. Builder and loader verified against the real registry extension, agent-server tests (240) pass, app typecheck clean; two file-length warnings noted as pre-existing at HEAD.
decisions: Split reload-all logic out of session-runtime-pool into its own module so neither session-runtime-pool.ts (now 298 lines) nor session-operations.ts (275 lines) exceeds the 300-line cap enforced by scripts/check-file-lengths.mjs.

Reload-all orchestrator lives in a new apps/agent-server/src/extensions/extension-reload.ts that combines extensionCatalogGeneration, rescanExtensionCatalog, reloadedExtensions, reloadAllSessions, and a broadcast hook, returning {generation, extensions, reloadedSessions, pendingSessions, diagnostics}.

Agent-server exposes a reloadRequest that routes through registry actions (full reload path includes 'registry.unlink'), the watch coordinator, the transport router, and the websocket connection subscribe so every socket sees the broadcast event.
pnpmlock.yaml diff accepted as dedupe only (jiti specifier added, @jridgewell/sourcemap-codec bump from 1.5.5 to 1.6.0).

Two pre-existing file-length errors at HEAD left as-is: apps/agent-server/tests/sessions/pi-agent-service-events.test.ts (331) and apps/app/src/lib/agent-client/agent-store/SessionCapability.ts (now 308).
errors: Typecheck reported `Cannot find name 'toasts'` in ExtensionsSettings.svelte (lines 79, 87); resolved by adding a toasts store import and adjusting the surrounding markup.

check-file-lengths.mjs reported pi-agent-service-events.test.ts at 331 lines and SessionCapability.ts at 308 lines; verified the 331-line test file is unchanged from HEAD, and only SessionCapability grew by 6 lines in this segment.
